journey.name: Signup — nothing is spent before its spender is there
journey.description:
The gate that keeps a user from paying for something they cannot use — and, since #147, the door out of it.
A signup token is single-use and costs an SMS attempt or sats. Who can *spend* it depends on which route the user took: a token redeemed through Pubky Ring needs Ring on the device, and a token redeemed in Loopky needs nothing at all. So the pre-check follows the **spender**, not the flow. With Ring missing the Ring route still refuses to ask Homegate for anything, and the Loopky route quotes prices and works.
Ring is *disabled* rather than uninstalled on purpose: uninstalling destroys the keys of the test accounts on the device.

actions.action: Disable Ring without removing it: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 to.pubky.ring
Verify "signup_ring_required_title" is present and reads "First, install Pubky Ring"
Verify BOTH method cards read "Needs Pubky Ring" in place of a price — "signup_method_lightning_price" must NOT show a sats figure, because a figure could only have come from Homegate
Verify logcat shows "load: Pubky Ring is not installed — not minting a token that cannot be spent", and no Homegate request
THE DOOR OUT (#147). Tap "signup_create_locally" — "Create the key in Loopky instead"
Verify the install block is GONE with Ring still disabled, and that "signup_method_lightning_price" now quotes sats — Homegate was asked, because this route can spend the token itself

Verify the fiat figure appears beside the sats one, e.g. "Pay ₿ 10 (≈ US$0.01) once". If the rate lookup fails it must read "Pay ₿ 10 once" with no placeholder and no spinner, and the card must stay tappable either way
Tap "signup_method_invite" and verify the screen moves — the local route has no Ring dependency to block on

THE RING ROUTE STILL GATES. Press back to onboarding, tap "onboarding_create_pubky" again, and verify the install block is back — the default spender is still Ring, and an unrecognised route argument must fall back to it rather than to local keys
Restore the device: adb shell pm enable to.pubky.ring
